title: Construction ban across Delhi-NCR from Nov 5; WFH curbs on the cards
firstParagraph: Dust-generating demolition and outdoor civil construction will be banned across the National Capital Region from November 5 to 20, Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav said on Friday, as the region enters what he called its “peak time” for air pollution. A work-from-home order is also being considered, officials said.
lastParagraph: These measures continue when higher GRAP stages are activated, subject to the applicable schedule.
